name: inspector-shell
title: Inspector shell
description: A list or table with a detail panel that opens beside it when a row is picked, with previous and next, and turns into a sheet on phones.
docs: Put the list or table in children and a search, filters or buttons in toolbar. Keep the selected record and open in your own state: set open when a row is picked, give the record's details as panel and its name as panelTitle, and answer onOpenChange(false) by closing. onPrevious and onNext walk the list: leave one out at the end and its button dims but keeps focus, so stepping with the keyboard never loses its place; leave both out for no buttons. Opening moves focus to the panel's heading (once the person has used the page: a panel that opens by itself on load does not take focus), Escape or the close button closes it and gives focus back to the row you pressed last (so put a real button or link in each row; a press elsewhere in the row counts as a press on its first one), and a change of record while open is announced. The panel opens by animating its width in 200ms, instantly under reduced motion. Below lg it is a sheet from the right with a focus trap; labels translates the words. The shell is as tall as its container: it is h-dvh unless you pass a height in className.
